fontSize.$description: Base font size for accessibility theme. Overrides app context default (14px) with larger size for better readability and accessibility compliance.

default.$description: Strong border color for maximum contrast in accessibility theme. Dark and highly visible for accessibility needs.

subtle.$description: Subtle border color with higher contrast for accessibility theme.

strong.$description: Strong border color for high-contrast separation in accessibility theme.

muted.$description: Secondary text with increased contrast for accessibility theme.

subtle.$description: Tertiary text with increased contrast for accessibility theme.

disabled.$description: Readable disabled text with improved contrast.

muted.$description: Muted background with stronger contrast vs surface for accessibility.

subtle.$description: Subtle background with clearer separation for accessibility theme.

small.$description: Smaller than default. Still visible but more subtle than baseline in friendly theme.

default.$description: Baseline for accessibility theme. Shifted up from minimal (4px) for softer, friendlier aesthetic. Standard components use this.

large.$description: Larger than default. Used for cards, panels. Hierarchical: default (8px) < large (10px) for nested aesthetics.

extra-large.$description: Much larger than default. Used for modals, dialogs. Clear hierarchy: default (8px) < large (10px) < extra-large (12px).
